description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Fanatical Firebrand that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Repeat using the Fanatical Firebrand token
